mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the channels was most worthwhile: the picture explained how an electrical change travels along a fibre through local movements of ions.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the receiving branches was clear but fairly predictable; the pieces and goal named the pairing directly.

surprise.text: I was surprised that no single ion travels the entire length of the fibre; neighbouring channels open in turn.
